gloss: signature song; representative piece; best-known work (of a musician or composer)

definitions.gloss: signature song; representative piece; best-known work (of a musician or composer)
definitions.explanation: signature song; representative piece; best-known work (of a musician or composer)

examples.japanese: この{曲|きょく}は{彼|かれ}の{代表曲|だいひょうきょく}だ。
examples.english: This song is his signature piece.

examples.japanese: コンサートの{最後|さいご}に{代表曲|だいひょうきょく}が{演奏|えんそう}された。
examples.english: The signature song was performed at the end of the concert.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}にはヒット{曲|きょく}が{多|おお}いが、{代表曲|だいひょうきょく}と{言|い}えばやはりデビュー{作|さく}だろう。
examples.english: She has many hit songs, but her signature piece is surely her debut release.

notes:
A compound of {代表|だいひょう} (representative) and {曲|きょく} (piece of music). Refers to the single most recognized or iconic work of a musician, band, or composer.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {代表曲|だいひょうきょく}と{言|い}えば: speaking of signature songs
- {代表曲|だいひょうきょく}を{歌|うた}う: to sing one's signature song
- {代表曲|だいひょうきょく}を{演奏|えんそう}する: to perform one's signature piece

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ヒット{曲|きょく}: hit song — a commercially successful song, but not necessarily the most representative one
- {名曲|めいきょく}: masterpiece, classic — a renowned piece of music regardless of who composed it
- {代表作|だいひょうさく}: representative work — the broader equivalent covering literature, film, art, etc., not just music
